precepts.text: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, Ephraim is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver.
precepts.point: The inhabitant shall not say, I am sick; the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity. Psalms 103:1-4, bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits, who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who healeth all thy diseases, who redeemeth thy life from destruction.

note.label: Hope Amid Destruction

precepts.why:
Isaiah says, “For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.” The Lord is our judge, not the nations. And the Lord is our lawgiver. Brothers used to get confused over this, so David shows which tribe the lawgiver comes from: “Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver”.

You would think it is supposed to be Levi, the priestly tribe. It says Judah. Why? Because the Lord who is our lawgiver came out of Judah, as Hebrews 7:14 shows. Christ is the lawgiver: he is the one that gave Moses the laws, and he is from Judah.

precepts.text: Moab is my washpot; the Most High set them beneath Israel as a servant.
precepts.point: The wickedness of Moab against the children of God is real history the American Board of Education does not teach: enslaving us during the Tang Dynasty, feeding the ghettos, and building whole industries off our people. All of it will be manifested and answered for.

note.label: Jeremiah 48: The Prophecy Against Moab

precepts.why:
Moab is exceeding proud, with his loftiness, his arrogancy, his pride and the haughtiness of his heart. David shows where the Most High set Moab: “Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.”

Moab is his washpot; the Most High set them beneath Israel as a servant. For all that pride, these Moabites will go back to their proper place and serve the nation of Israel for what they have done. The wickedness of Moab against the children of God is real history the American Board of Education does not teach: enslaving us during the Tang Dynasty, feeding the ghettos, and building whole industries off our people. All of it will be manifested and answered for.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why: God scattered us, and “He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.” That is what you are seeing now: he is gathering us again.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why: The same precept: “When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered”. We are scattered among the nations. “Then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.”

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why: In the New Testament: “James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.” We were scattered; that is what slavery was all about, scattering our race, our kingdom and our people.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
The banner: “Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain”. The banner is the Bible, and the high mountain is the highest government in the world, Babylon. “Exalt the voice unto them”: don’t sound like a simp or a squirrel. “Shake the hand”: when you shake the hand you are rebuking and correcting, “that they may go into the gates of the nobles.”

That is the gathering of the twelve tribes: Judah, Benjamin, Levi, Ephraim, Manasseh, Simeon, Zebulun, Gad, Reuben, Asher, Issachar and Naphtali, assembled for war.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
Everybody thinks God wants everybody together. “When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.” The twelve tribes got the best land and all the other nations were set around us.

Christianity wants to bring all races together because it comes from ancient Babylon: the Tower of Babel was bringing everybody together against God, and it is the same today. All nations are not supposed to be together; they are supposed to be separated. That was God’s plan. The white man calls that racist while he builds weapons to go into space to fight against God.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why: “For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.” The Lord who is our lawgiver is Christ.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why: “For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.” The new priesthood was Judah. Judah is the lawgiver because Christ, the Lord, came out of Judah. He is the lawgiver.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why: What does “Philistia, triumph thou because of me” mean? Psalm 108 says it plainly: “Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.” God will triumph over Philistia, which is Palestine; we are going to triumph over Philistia.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
Who will lead God into Edom? “Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah?” Bozrah is the capital of Edom. “I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save”: that is Christ.

“Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?” Isaiah asks why there is red all over his clothes, as if he had been stomping grapes. “I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me”: I don’t need the Israelites to help me. “For I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.” He will tread Edom in his anger.

So the Son of God knows exactly who he is coming back to fight. Edom is not done away with.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why: “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea”. Christ’s sword comes down on Idumea. Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. When Christians say Edom was done away with thousands of years ago, that is a lie.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
“But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.” When we fought Edom in the dark ages and the Renaissance, God did not go out with our armies, and we had armies. Images of black men in Europe show us as knights, St. Maurice among them, in castles with bows and arrows, swords and lances. We were not just running naked through Africa with bones in our noses like the Tarzan movies; we were more than that.

“Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.” We ran from our enemies, and the white man defeated us, robbed us, beat us and destroyed us, because God did not go forth with us.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
Through God we shall do valiantly, but to do valiantly we must return to what the Bible says we are and what it says we must do. “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope”: the stronghold is God’s laws, his word. “Even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”.

“When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim”: he raises Judah first and uses Judah and Ephraim like weapons of war, “and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece”. You never read that in church. We will be raised up against the white man, not today but when the Lord returns, “and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.” That is the valiantly of Psalm 60:12.

“And the Lord shall be seen over them”: that is how you know it is not right now; we are not ready. “The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine”, as if we were drunk, partying.

“And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.” Each man and woman like the rubies in a crown, lifted up and delivered from destruction, and all the world will see the twelve tribes of Israel. “For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty!”

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
“And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the Lord”: we are going to be everywhere, “as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men”, because God is our king.

“And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep”: not an old lion but a young lion. What can sheep do to a lion? Nothing but be food. “Who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.” We are going to tread down the nations and tear them in pieces.

“Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.” All of them. That is God treading down our enemies.

note.label: Gods Memorial: The Smoke of Her Torment

precepts.why:
“Thou hast made the earth to tremble”: Christ is going to make the earth tremble, meaning the earth is going to shake. There is gonna be an earthquake when Christ returns. “Thou hast broken it”: when Christ returns he gonna break the earth, the way the earth revolves; the earth is going to move off of its axis. “Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh”, for the earth is shaken. The class read on: “Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.”

That is what Isaiah means by “the earth shall remove out of her place”: the earth will be shaken and broken out of its place in the day the Lord touches down.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “Moab is my washpot”. Moab is China; they always have the laundromats, and they made a laundry commercial mocking us, washing the black off. In the kingdom they are going to wash whatever we tell them to wash. “Over Edom will I cast out my shoe”: throwing a shoe is a sign of disrespect, as when a journalist threw a shoe at George Bush. It is get out of my house, the way you throw a shoe at a dog. That is what God is going to do to the white man. “Philistia, triumph thou because of me.”

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?” Jehovah’s Witnesses teach that Edom is done away with, that King Saul killed all of Edom. That is a lie; the prophecy asks who will lead God into Edom. Edom would be the strongest city, the strongest kingdom on earth: the strong city of Edom is Babylon the great.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?” We prayed, you didn’t go out with our armies before; we lost the battle and went into slavery.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.” That is the prayer of Judah, hear, Lord, the voice of Judah. Vain is the help of man: you can’t get help from the Arabs or from Russia.
